Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 21 (6d6)

These military-grade cyberarms from Moore Technologies boast some of the most powerful synthetic muscles ever made.

Paired Cyberarms. Borgware. They must be installed together and count as a single item for the purposes of Cost and Humanity Loss but not Critical Injuries or repair. Each Cyberarm has 1 Option Slot for Cyberarm or Cyberlimb Options, and comes pre-installed with Gorilla Arm (w/ Tungsten Reinforcement) and Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade, neither of which cause any Humanity Loss or take up a Cyberarm Option Slot. None of the pre-installed items can be removed.

NOTE: Based on an in-game Cyberpunk 2077 TV broadcast that showcases these arms.

Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 1

Foundry notes:

  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together. It carries 1 Option Slot, the count for one arm; add a second copy or raise the slots by hand if your table tracks each arm separately.
  • The pre-installed Gorilla Arm and Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade are described here rather than installed as separate items.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
